title: Extra Shot
text:
The opposing player may choose
one of your models. Then, you may
choose two other friendly models.
The friendly models you chose gain
1 TAC and may Sprint without
spending influence.

title: Feign Injury
text:
Once this turn, when selecting a
friendly model to activate, if there
are one or more friendly models
currently suffering the taken out
condition that have not activated,
you may force the opposing player
to select an enemy model to activate
instead. When you do, select a
friendly model to recover 4 HP.

title: Set Me Up
text:
A friendly model may immediately
make a pass to another friendly
model. Models cannot generate MP,
use Pass & Move, or make a Snap
Shot as a result of this pass.

title: Pep Talk
text:
Once per activation, friendly models
may use Bonus Time without
spending MP.

title: Lost Focus
text:
Choose one of the following:
• The first time an enemy model
makes a kick, they suffer –1/–2"
KICK for the duration of the action.
• The first time a friendly model is
damaged by an enemy attack or play,
the friendly model may recover 3 HP
after the action is resolved.

title: High Press
text:
Up to two friendly Squaddie models
may make a 2" dodge towards the
enemy goal post.

title: Home Advantage
text:
When an enemy model scores a goal,
the friendly team gains 2 MP. When
making a goal kick after an enemy
model has scored a goal, you may
spend 1 MP to reroll the kick scatter.

title: No Guts, No Glory
text:
Choose a friendly non-Mascot model
on the pitch. The chosen model
suffers 5 DMG.

title: Adrenaline Rush
text:
Once this turn, a friendly model may
use Rest without spending MP.

title: Big Rivals
text:
Choose a friendly model and an
enemy model. The chosen models
suffer a 1" push directly towards each
other.

title: Man Marking
text:
Choose an enemy Squaddie model.
The chosen model suffers Marked
Target.
detail:
(Marked Target: When a friendly
model charges target enemy model, the
friendly model gains +0"/+2" MOV for
the duration of the charge.)

title: Match Fixing
text:
Predict aloud whether the first
time your opponent scores VP this
turn will be as a result of a goal or
a take down. If your prediction is
correct, you may allocate 2 influence
between up to two friendly models.

title: Nowhere to Hide
text:
Choose an obstruction, barrier,
or forest on the pitch. The chosen
terrain piece doesn’t provide the
benefit of cover.

title: Catenaccio
text:
Choose a friendly Squaddie model.
The chosen model gains Backfield
Presence.
detail:
(Backfield Presence: While attacking a
model that is in possession of the ball,
this model gains +2 TAC.)

title: Rushed Back
text:
The first enemy model that returns
to the pitch this turn after removing
the taken out condition suffers the
bleed condition.

title: WHAT A STRIKE!
text: Friendly models gain Goal of the Month.

title: Brown Envelope
text:
The first time you select a model to
activate, the opposing player chooses
–1"/–1" MOV or –1 TAC. The
selected model suffers the chosen
effect.

title: Gengenpress
text:
When your opponent ends their first
activation, you may remove up to 2
influence from a friendly model and
allocate it to another friendly model.
